note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A): every expect and until is derived by hand from the 28-wire topology and the p.31 rule (dots and dashes told apart by how long light 6 is on; SOS), not printed; the printed fixture C2/V-EXP18 covers transmission starting at power on and stopping at power off. No erratum changes a wire (ER-37 is prose), so the wires are as printed. Topology: the wiper D16 is tied to + and D17 is +, D18 is -, so the motor runs whenever power is on; D1-D3, D6-D8 and D11-D13 tie to 6A (light 6, and relay 3 self-interrupting through its own N.C. contact 3J-3H-3E, so it buzzes on every lit contact and is asserted only where unfed); D4 sets relay 6 (6G/D4, coil in series with its indicator lamp to 6C/6-), which latches 6H(+)-6G-6F; D9 (6E/D9) puts + on both ends of the coil and releases it; relay 6's set 2 (6L/D18, 6K/5F) puts coils and indicator lamps 4 and 5, all in parallel between D19 and 4C/4F/5C/5F, across the motor terminals D19-D18 from D4 to D9, so the motor is shunted and slows over the O dashes (Book VII p.21 resistance across STOP slows the motor, rotary.md 3.2 condition 6). Relays 4 and 5 contacts are unwired; they are loads only, and whether they pull in under the shunt is not derivable (motor voltage), so they and their indicator lamps are asserted only while relay 6 is out. Script choices, not printed: the dial starts at c0 (construction state); lamp states are asserted only where the lamp has been unfed for at least one pad; maxMs values confine each until to the intended revolution. The ER-37 held-back revolution is scripted as dialGrab steps to pad centres and dead-gap centres (pad N at N x 22.5 deg, gap centre at N x 22.5 + 11.25 deg), which lie in the gap under any contact arc below the 22.5 deg pitch (O-R1); wiper_offset_udeg 0 is the profile assumption. Not asserted: the dash-versus-dot dwell ratio (needs a timing comparison and rests on the O-R5 motor resistances), light 6 in the gaps while running (lamp cooling is a profile constant), relay 3 on any lit contact (buzzing), relays 4 and 5 under the shunt, and the dial rest after power off. If relay 6 fails to latch in the D4 dwell at run speed, script[2] fails first.
